As housekeeper, the kitchen is my primary workplace.
And no matter how many times I see it, I'm still impressed by this place.
Even though it's in a rural area, the indoor environment is far from neglected. It's beautiful and quite tidy.
It's evident that they cherish this place a lot and come from a wealthy family.
“Just checking in to see how you're doing, are you getting used to being here?”
“That's good to hear. I was worried you might find it hard to adjust.”
“After all, it's quite rural here. There's poor cell reception, not much interesting stuff around, and lots of bugs...”
“Not at all, it's peaceful and quiet, and the people in the village are really friendly.”
“Plus, the rooms have soft beds, a huge upgrade from where I used to live!”
“Ah, I asked Shizuko about some things concerning you...”
“So I'm really grateful to you and your sisters for giving me this opportunity—”
“I'll do my best, and if there's anything I'm not doing right, please let me know!”
“Hehe, don't worry about it, chin up.”
“Like I said before, we're not great at cooking, so we're really counting on you for that!”
“Leave it to me, I'll make sure you have delicious meals every day!”
“I'm looking forward to it—So, are you planning to cook dinner now?”
“Actually... I'm kind of interested in cooking...”
“Just never really been good at it...”
“So, if it's possible... I hope I can watch how you do it...”
“If you want to learn, I can teach you.”
“What are you planning to make for dinner tonight, {Me}?”
“Kasumi, is there anything in particular you'd like to eat?”
“I'm kind of in the mood for something warm and comforting.”
“How about oden then? We have the ingredients in the fridge.”
“Oh— that's a great idea, Ayano and Shizuku love it too!”
“For oden, we'll need a big pot!”
“All our pots are stored over here...”
Kasumi suddenly turns her back to me and squats down, searching through the storage cabinet.
As she looks for the pot, her posture gradually becomes, well... *cough*
From where I'm standing, I can't help but notice her extremely enticing butt.
“Anyway, let's get started. Making the soup base will take some time!”
